title: My Fursona's Past, Present and Future

slides.text:
AftDawn started out as a simple Protogen, the name was adapted from my old Xbox Gamertag (i just cut off the numbers at the end). I didn't really exert any control over the creative process, so stuff like the fur patterns, colours, or general "Vibe" of my fursona was not dictated by me, but I still feel he ended up in a good place.

This piece was the first bit of art I ever commissioned, and for the price of one month of discord nitro

Soon after getting the Headshot, I realized that I'll definitely want to get a full Refsheet of my boy, so I did. In hindsight I don't really like the proportions that he has in this one, but hey, I could claim that I have a Refsheet, which would allow me to open the doors to getting art!

AftDawn during the Protogen days was partly me and partly my computer. This form does fit well with my original gaming computer named Kevin, he was big and bulky and honestly wouldn't be all that powerful nowadays (AMD FX chip, dual RX 560's). But he was my first real gaming computer, just like how this ref was my first real Refsheet

slides.imageName: AftDawn's Remastered Refsheet. Artist: Lilly_Mega (Discord, Telegram, Twitter, Carrd, FurAffinity)
slides.text:
So I decided to get a better Refsheet, a WAY better ref sheet. This also came at a time where I was downsizing a lot of my life, so I was mostly using a Steam Deck for my gaming, which is slim and svelte. Just like how the old StarriEyedd Refsheet was partly me and partly my gaming computer, this Refsheet is partly me and partly my Steam Deck named Juan

So that influenced my decisions surrounding the style, look and "feel" surrounding this new AftDawn, when I was talking to Lilly_Mega, my mum got a new dog named Whittaker, he's a king charles cavalier. The though of giving Aft some of those features (floppy ears, big floofy tail) cropped up, so I pulled the trigger and I think he looks a million times better because of it

slides.imageName: Protovali AftDawn's Refsheet. Artist: Lilly_Mega (Discord, Telegram, Twitter, Carrd, FurAffinity)
slides.text:
At the same time that I got the new Lilly_Mega Refsheet, I also was dabbling around with alternate universe versions of Aft, so I commissioned this form alongside the standard Protogen form. In one of these AU's, AftDawn is a Protovali (Protogen + Avali).

AftDawn nowadays had a lot of AU forms

slides.imageName: "The Change" Artist: TuxedoDragon (Personal Site, Critter.cafe, Tumblr, FurAffinity, Bluesky)
slides.text:
AftDawn never expected this when he woke up in his motel bed on Avalon, the Avali home world, his armour spread all around him, strange, new feelings and… two extra arms. "What the hell happened to me"? The freshly minted Amphimorpho whispered to himself.

Turns out that when you touch some glowing goop in a back ally on Avalon, that you might just be forced to change species


This art came later in the in real life timeline, but this section of my website is not about the in real life lore, but the in character lore told mostly as an outsider. This piece is one that I love with all my heart, the emotion, the lighting, the visor saying that "vital signs not detected", this piece is perfect. It symbolizes the end of one era and the start of the next, hence the name I gave it ("The Change") .

I will say, I have always seen AftDawn as both me and not me, he can be just a funny character, or a self insert, depending on the situation. It's weird in a way, but it's always how I've rolled
